title: John Muir: A Brief Biography
creator: Sierra Club, John Muir Exhibit
gloss: Chronology source: born Dunbar 1838; family emigrated to Wisconsin in 1849 (Fountain Lake, then Hickory Hill); University of Wisconsin from 1860; 1867 eye injury and thousand-mile walk; landed San Francisco March 1868; 1874 writing career; married Louie Strentzel 1880; Sierra Club 1892; Our National Parks 1901; Roosevelt's 1903 visit; Hetch Hetchy lost 1913; died 1914.
